title: Ulita — the savings board
subtitle: a modern reading
intent: Cash flow is strategy: move small amounts through your accounts and bank them the moment they group into a matured four.

start.text: Read the old counting board as money: each pit is an account, each seed a coin. Circulate your coins; whenever an account holds exactly four, it matures and you bank it.
Financial sense, on an ancient board — plan the flow, don't just spend the biggest pile first.

capture.text: An account matures at four and is banked. Wealth is built by grouping small amounts, not by chasing one big pile.
Four coins secured. A single well-timed move can mature several accounts down the line — that is compounding.
Banked. Managing the flow beats hoarding; move the seeds so the fours fall to you.

win.text: The table is settled and your bank holds the most. Steady, planned circulation won it — not luck.

lose.text: The other bank is fuller. Watch where the fours mature next time and route your coins toward them.
